size.value: 5cm x 5cm, described officially as 'tipo visa' (visa-type format) — applies to passport applications processed at Uruguayan consulates abroad.

glasses_policy.value: No glasses or accessories are permitted on the face or head ('sin lentes o accesorio en rostro y cabeza').

file_spec.value: For domestic applications at DNIC (Dirección Nacional de Identificación Civil) offices within Uruguay, the photo is taken live on-site by the official at the appointment — applicants do not bring their own photo. For consular applications abroad (e.g. the Ecuador embassy's 'Operativo Pasaporte'), the photo is submitted digitally as a PDF email attachment ahead of the appointment.

glasses.en: No glasses or accessories are permitted on the face or head.
glasses.ko: 얼굴이나 머리에 안경이나 액세서리를 착용할 수 없다.
glasses.ja: 顔や頭に眼鏡やアクセサリーを着用することはできない。

db_conflicts.research_value: 5cm x 5cm ('tipo visa'), confirmed identically on two separate official gub.uy (Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores) consular pages — a different, larger, square-ish size than the DB's 35x45mm. Note: for domestic DNIC applications within Uruguay itself, the photo is captured live on-site and no user-submitted size applies at all.

cross_verification.note_en: The 5cm x 5cm / white background / no-glasses-or-accessories spec was read directly and identically on two separate gub.uy pages (Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores consular pages for the Ecuador embassy: 'Renovación de pasaporte común' and 'Operativo Pasaporte'), which strengthens confidence despite being consular (abroad) rather than domestic DNIC procedure. Direct fetch of dnic.minterior.gub.uy (redirects to gub.uy/ministerio-interior/direccion-nacional-identificacion-civil) confirmed DNIC exists and handles domestic passport issuance but that specific page carried no technical photo spec of its own — it was used only to corroborate the 'live capture on-site, no submitted photo' finding for domestic applications, which is separately supported by third-party consumer guidance (not independently cited as verified here).
